{{Short description|Prism with an 8-sided base}}

[[File:Octagonal prism.stl|thumb|3D model of a uniform octagonal prism]]
In [[geometry]], the '''octagonal prism''' is a [[Prism (geometry)|prism]] comprising eight rectangular sides joining two regular [[octagon]] caps.

== Symmetry ==

|- align=center

|'''Ditetragonal prism''' 
|'''Ditetragonal trapezoprism'''
|- align=center

|- align=center

|D<sub>4h</sub>, [2,4], (*422)
|D<sub>4d</sub>, [2<sup>+</sup>,8], (2*4)
|- align=center
!Construction
|tr{4,2} or t{4}×{}, {{CDD|node_1|2|node_1|4|node_1}}
|s<sub>2</sub>{2,8}, {{CDD|node_h|2x|node_h|8|node_1}}
|}

== Images ==
The octagonal prism can also be seen as a tiling on a sphere:
:[[File:Spherical octagonal prism.svg|240px]]

== Use ==

In [[optics]], octagonal prisms are used to generate flicker-free images in [[movie projector]]s.

== In uniform honeycombs and 4-polytopes ==
It is an element of three [[uniform honeycomb]]s:

|- align=center
|[[Truncated square prismatic honeycomb]]<BR>{{CDD|node_1|4|node_1|4|node|2|node_1|infin|node}}

|[[Runcitruncated cubic honeycomb]]<BR>{{CDD|node_1|4|node_1|3|node|4|node_1}}
|- align=center
|[[File:Truncated square prismatic honeycomb.png|160px]]
|[[File:Omnitruncated cubic honeycomb.jpg|160px]]
|[[File:Runcitruncated cubic honeycomb.jpg|160px]]

It is also an element of two four-dimensional [[uniform 4-polytope]]s:
